info.title: AURELION Manager WebAPI V1
info.description:
The AURELION Manager is a software application with a graphical user interface to manage and configure the AURELION system. It is installed with the AURELION tools suite that is required to setup an AURELION system.
API Error Codes: | Status Code | Error Code | Description | |-------------|------------|-------------| | 400 | ERR_MISSING_NAME | Name cannot be empty. | | 400 | ERR_IMAGE_FILE_NOT_FOUND | Image file does not exist. | | 400 | ERR_REPLAY_SCENARIO_IS_FORBIDDEN | Creation and modification of 'Replay' scenarios is not allowed. | | 400 | ERR_NOT_AN_OPENSCENARIO | The scenario is not of the OpenSCENARIO type. | | 400 | ERR_MISSING_XOSC_FILE_PATH | OpenSCENARIO file path must be provided for the OpenSCENARIO type. | | 400 | ERR_XOSC_FILE_NOT_FOUND | OpenSCENARIO file does not exist. | | 400 | ERR_3D_ENV_PATH_NOT_FOUND | 3D environment path does not exist. | | 400 | ERR_BAD_REQUEST | Bad request. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_JSON | Could not create or update the resource. The JSON structure of the provided data is invalid. | | 400 | ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED | Validation failed. | | 400 | ERR_ID_MISMATCH | Could not create or update the resource. The provided ID and the ID in the provided data do not match. | | 400 | ERR_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED | Could not create or update the resource. The provided data contains invalid or missing properties. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_SCENERY | The scenario contains an invalid scenery. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_RSG_VEGETATION_GENERATION_DENSITY | The density must be >= 0 & <= 100. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_RSG_VEGETATION_GENERATION_CORRIDOR | The generation corridor end value must be higher than the start value. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_RSG_MATERIAL_DAMAGE_ROAD_MARKING_DAMAGE | Road marking damage must be >= 0 & <= 100. | | 400 | ERR_INVALID_RSG_MATERIAL_DAMAGE_ROAD_MARKING_BRIGHTNESS | Road marking brightness must be >= 0 & <= 100. | | 400 | ERR_INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED | Validation failed. The provided structure is correct but the values do not meet the requirements. | | 400 | ERR_MISSING_AUR_SCENE_PATH | The AURELION environment path cannot be empty. | | 404 | ERR_NOT_FOUND | Not found. | | 412 | ERR_PROJECT_NOT_OPEN | No open project. Open a project first. | | 422 | ERR_SETTING_VALIDATION_FAILED | Could not create or update the resource. The provided structure is valid but the resource itself contains errors. | | 422 | ERR_SCENARIO_VALIDATION_FAILED | Scenario validation failed. | | 500 | ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR | Internal server error. | | 500 | ERR_OPENX_VALIDATION_FAILED | Scenario validation failed. |
